# scripts/UI/MenuWash.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../../../../../../Users/tinkertailorr/a-world-of-darkness-alpha/scripts/UI/MenuWash.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../../../../../../../Users/tinkertailorr/a-world-of-darkness-alpha/docs/systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

A word's own painting, washed in around it at full colour. It blooms in
when its word is chosen and fades out when another is; it never travels.

Base: `Control`. Registered class: `MenuWash`.
